## Problem / motivation
What problem would this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see (new module, variable, behavior, doc, etc.).

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about.

## Cost / security impact
Does this add paid resources or change the security posture? It should be
optional and off by default if it incurs cost.

## Additional context
Links, references, examples.
